speaker: job
text: Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts.
name: Job

speaker: god
text: Where have you come from?
name: The LORD

speaker: satan
text: From roaming through the earth,
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: and walking back and forth in it.
name: Satan

speaker: god
text: Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil.
name: The LORD

speaker: satan
text: Does Job fear God for nothing?
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: Have You not placed a hedge on every side around him and his household and all that he owns? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: But stretch out Your hand and strike all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face.
name: Satan

speaker: god
text: Very well,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Everything he has is in your hands, but you must not lay a hand on the man himself.
name: The LORD

speaker: messenger
text: While the oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,
name: A messenger

speaker: messenger
text: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!
name: A messenger

speaker: messenger
text: The fire of God fell from heaven. It burned and consumed the sheep and the servants, and I alone have escaped to tell you!
name: A messenger

speaker: messenger
text: The Chaldeans formed three bands, raided the camels, and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!
name: A messenger

speaker: messenger
text: Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
name: A messenger

speaker: messenger
text: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on the young people and they are dead, and I alone have escaped to tell you!
name: A messenger

speaker: job
text: Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.
name: Job

speaker: god
text: Where have you come from?
name: The LORD

speaker: satan
text: From roaming through the earth,
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: and walking back and forth in it.
name: Satan

speaker: god
text: Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil. He still retains his integrity, even though you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause.
name: The LORD

speaker: satan
text: Skin for skin!
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life.
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: But stretch out Your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse You to Your face.
name: Satan

speaker: god
text: Very well,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He is in your hands, but you must spare his life.
name: The LORD

speaker: job-wife
text: Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!
name: Job's wife

speaker: job
text: You speak as a foolish woman speaks,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Should we accept from God only good and not adversity?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: May the day of my birth perish, and the night it was said, ‘A boy is conceived.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only that day had turned to darkness! May God above disregard it; may no light shine upon it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: May darkness and gloom reclaim it, and a cloud settle over it; may the blackness of the day overwhelm it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only darkness had taken that night away! May it not appear among the days of the year; may it never be entered in any of the months.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Behold, may that night be barren; may no joyful voice come into it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: May it be cursed by those who curse the day— those prepared to rouse Leviathan.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: May its morning stars grow dark; may it wait in vain for daylight; may it not see the breaking of dawn.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For that night did not shut the doors of the womb to hide the sorrow from my eyes.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why did I not perish at birth; why did I not die as I came from the womb?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why were there knees to receive me, and breasts that I should be nursed?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
name: Job

speaker: job
text: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves cities now in ruins,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: There the wicked cease from raging, and there the weary find rest.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Both small and great are there, and the slave is freed from his master.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why is light given to the miserable, and life to the bitter of soul,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: who long for death that does not come, and search for it like hidden treasure,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: who rejoice and greatly exult when they can find the grave?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I sigh when food is put before me, and my groans pour out like water.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I am not at ease or quiet; I have no rest, for trouble has come.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only my grief could be weighed and placed with my calamity on the scales.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For then it would outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been rash.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass, or an ox low over its fodder?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope:
name: Job

speaker: job
text: that God would be willing to crush me, to unleash His hand and cut me off!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What is my future, that I should be patient?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is my strength like that of stone, or my flesh made of bronze?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is there any help within me now that success is driven from me?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But my brothers are as faithless as wadis, as seasonal streams that overflow,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: darkened because of the ice and the inflow of melting snow,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: but ceasing in the dry season and vanishing from their channels in the heat.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go into the wasteland and perish.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The caravans of Tema look for water; the travelers of Sheba hope to find it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They are confounded because they had hoped; their arrival brings disappointment.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For now you are of no help; you see terror, and you are afraid.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Have I ever said, ‘Give me something; offer me a bribe from your wealth;
name: Job

speaker: job
text: deliver me from the hand of the enemy; redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless’?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Teach me, and I will be silent. Help me understand how I have erred.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Do you intend to correct my words, and treat as wind my cry of despair?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away your friend.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But now, please look at me. Would I lie to your face?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is there iniquity on my tongue? Can my mouth not discern malice?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is not man consigned to labor on earth? Are not his days like those of a hired hand?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Like a slave he longs for shade; like a hireling he waits for his wages.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When I lie down I think: ‘When will I get up?’ But the night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My flesh is clothed with worms and encrusted with dirt; my skin is cracked and festering.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Remember that my life is but a breath. My eyes will never again see happiness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The eye that beholds me will no longer see me. You will look for me, but I will be no more.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come back up.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He never returns to his house; his place remembers him no more.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that You must keep me under guard?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then You frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: so that I would prefer strangling and death over my life in this body.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I loathe my life! I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: that You attend to him every morning, and test him every moment?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why do You not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For soon I will lie down in the dust; You will seek me, but I will be no more.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If one wished to contend with God, he could not answer Him one time out of a thousand.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He shakes the earth from its place, so that its foundations tremble.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He commands the sun not to shine; He seals off the stars.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Were He to pass by me, I would not see Him; were He to move, I would not recognize Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If He takes away, who can stop Him? Who dares to ask Him, ‘What are You doing?’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: God does not restrain His anger; the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How then can I answer Him or choose my arguments against Him?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For even if I were right, I could not answer. I could only beg my Judge for mercy.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I summoned Him and He answered me, I do not believe He would listen to my voice.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He does not let me catch my breath, but overwhelms me with bitterness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If it is a matter of strength, He is indeed mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even if I were righteous, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would declare me guilty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It is all the same, and so I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When the scourge brings sudden death, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He blindfolds its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My days are swifter than a runner; they flee without seeing good.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They sweep by like boats of papyrus, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I were to say, ‘I will forget my complaint and change my expression and smile,’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I would still dread all my sufferings; I know that You will not acquit me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Since I am already found guilty, why should I labor in vain?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then You would plunge me into the pit, and even my own clothes would despise me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For He is not a man like me, that I can answer Him, that we can take each other to court.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Nor is there a mediator between us, to lay his hand upon us both.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Let Him remove His rod from me, so that His terror will no longer frighten me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Then I would speak without fear of Him. But as it is, I am on my own.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Do You have eyes of flesh? Do You see as man sees?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Are Your days like those of a mortal, or Your years like those of a man,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me. Would You now turn and destroy me?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Did You not pour me out like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet You concealed these things in Your heart, and I know that this was in Your mind:
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me. Hardships assault me in wave after wave.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only I had never come to be, but had been carried from the womb to the grave.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Are my days not few? Withdraw from me, that I may have a little comfort,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: before I go—never to return— to a land of darkness and gloom,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: to a land of utter darkness, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But I also have a mind; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The tents of robbers are safe, and those who provoke God are secure— those who carry their god in their hands.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Wisdom is found with the elderly, and understanding comes with long life.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Wisdom and strength belong to God; counsel and understanding are His.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If He holds back the waters, they dry up, and if He releases them, they overwhelm the land.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: True wisdom and power belong to Him. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He makes nations great and destroys them; He enlarges nations, then disperses them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They grope in the darkness without light; He makes them stagger like drunkards.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Indeed, my eyes have seen all this; my ears have heard and understood.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Hear now my argument, and listen to the plea of my lips.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Would it be well when He examined you? Could you deceive Him like a man?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Would His majesty not terrify you? Would the dread of Him not fall upon you?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Be silent, and I will speak. Then let come to me what may.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why do I put myself at risk and take my life in my own hands?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Listen carefully to my words; let my declaration ring in your ears.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Behold, now that I have prepared my case, I know that I will be vindicated.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Can anyone indict me? If so, I will be silent and die.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Only grant these two things to me, so that I need not hide from You:
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How many are my iniquities and sins? Reveal to me my transgression and sin.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Do You open Your eyes to one like this? Will You bring him into judgment before You?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: look away from him and let him rest, so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, he will not be awakened or roused from sleep.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed! If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You will call, and I will answer; You will desire the work of Your hands.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For then You would count my steps, but would not keep track of my sin.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You forever overpower him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If his sons receive honor, he does not know it; if they are brought low, he is unaware.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
name: Job

speaker: job
text: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Give me, I pray, the pledge You demand. Who else will be my guarantor?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore You will not exalt them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent are stirred against the godless.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My days have passed; my plans are broken off— even the desires of my heart.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They have turned night into day, making light seem near in the face of darkness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: and say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Listen carefully to my words; let this be your consolation to me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Is my complaint against a man? Then why should I not be impatient?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Look at me and be appalled; put your hand over your mouth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When I remember, terror takes hold, and my body trembles in horror.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Their descendants are established around them, and their offspring before their eyes.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Their homes are safe from fear; no rod of punishment from God is upon them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Their bulls breed without fail; their cows bear calves and do not miscarry.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They send forth their little ones like a flock; their children skip about,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: singing to the tambourine and lyre and making merry at the sound of the flute.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet they say to God: ‘Leave us alone! For we have no desire to know Your ways.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain if we pray to Him?’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Still, their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It is said that God lays up one’s punishment for his children. Let God repay the man himself, so he will know it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For what does he care about his household after him, when the number of his months has run out?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since He judges those on high?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: One man dies full of vigor, completely secure and at ease.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His body is well nourished, and his bones are rich with marrow.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, having never tasted prosperity.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But together they lie down in the dust, and worms cover them both.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Behold, I know your thoughts full well, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For you say, ‘Where now is the nobleman’s house, and where are the tents in which the wicked dwell?’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Have you never asked those who travel the roads? Do you not accept their reports?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Indeed, the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, delivered from the day of wrath.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Who denounces his behavior to his face? Who repays him for what he has done?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; everyone follows behind him, and those before him are without number.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: So how can you comfort me with empty words? For your answers remain full of falsehood.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If only I knew where to find Him, so that I could go to His seat.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I would plead my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I would learn how He would answer, and consider what He would say.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Would He contend with me in His great power? No, He would certainly take note of me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Then an upright man could reason with Him, and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For He carries out His decree against me, and He has many such plans.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Therefore I am terrified in His presence; when I consider this, I fear Him.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment? Why may those who know Him never see His days?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Men move boundary stones; they pasture stolen flocks.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Indeed, like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go to work foraging for food; the wasteland is food for their children.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Without clothing, they spend the night naked; they have no covering against the cold.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Drenched by mountain rains, they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The fatherless infant is snatched from the breast; the nursing child of the poor is seized for a debt.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Without clothing, they wander about naked. They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: From the city, men groan, and the souls of the wounded cry out, yet God charges no one with wrongdoing.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Then there are those who rebel against the light, not knowing its ways or staying on its paths.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy; in the night he is like a thief.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight. Thinking, ‘No eye will see me,’ he covers his face.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves in, never to experience the light.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For to them, deep darkness is their morning; surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They are but foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one turns toward their vineyards.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: As drought and heat consume the melting snow, so Sheol steals those who have sinned.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is like a broken tree.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They prey on the barren and childless, and show no kindness to the widow.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet by His power, God drags away the mighty; though rising up, they have no assurance of life.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He gives them a sense of security, but His eyes are on their ways.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They are exalted for a moment, then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If this is not so, then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The dead tremble— those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice— the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I will never say that you are right; I will maintain my integrity until I die.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: May my enemy be like the wicked and my opponent like the unjust.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Will he delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely all of you have seen it for yourselves. Why then do you keep up this empty talk?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: This is the wicked man’s portion from God— the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Though his sons are many, they are destined for the sword; and his offspring will never have enough food.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: His survivors will be buried by the plague, and their widows will not weep for them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Though he heaps up silver like dust and piles up a wardrobe like clay,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: what he lays up, the righteous will wear, and his silver will be divided by the innocent.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut set up by a watchman.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest sweeps him away in the night.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It claps its hands at him and hisses him out of his place.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Man puts an end to the darkness; he probes the farthest recesses for ore in deepest darkness.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Far from human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man. Far from men he dangles and sways.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Food may come from the earth, but from below it is transformed as by fire.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: No bird of prey knows that path; no falcon’s eye has seen it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Proud beasts have never trodden it; no lion has ever prowled over it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The miner strikes the flint; he overturns mountains at their base.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He hews out channels in the rocks, and his eyes spot every treasure.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But where can wisdom be found, and where does understanding dwell?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: No man can know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The ocean depths say, ‘It is not in me,’ while the sea declares, ‘It is not with me.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It cannot be bought with gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it, nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it, nor can it be valued in pure gold.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: From where then does wisdom come, and where does understanding dwell?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Abaddon and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor about it.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it; He established it and searched it out.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: when His lamp shone above my head, and by His light I walked through the darkness,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
name: Job

speaker: job
text: When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the old men rose to their feet.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roofs of their mouths.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For those who heard me called me blessed, and those who saw me commended me,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I served as eyes to the blind and as feet to the lame.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I was a father to the needy, and I took up the case of the stranger.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: So I thought: ‘I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My glory is ever new within me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Men listened to me with expectation, waiting silently for my counsel.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They waited for me as for rain and drank in my words like spring showers.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I smiled at them, they did not believe it; the light of my countenance was precious.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I chose their course and presided as chief. So I dwelt as a king among his troops, as a comforter of the mourners.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But now they mock me, men younger than I am, whose fathers I would have refused to entrust with my sheep dogs.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: What use to me was the strength of their hands, since their vigor had left them?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Gaunt from poverty and hunger, they gnawed the dry land, and the desolate wasteland by night.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They plucked mallow among the shrubs, and the roots of the broom tree were their food.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They were banished from among men, shouted down like thieves,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: A senseless and nameless brood, they were driven off the land.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They abhor me and keep far from me; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They tear up my path; they profit from my destruction, with no one to restrain them.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: They advance as through a wide breach; through the ruins they keep rolling in.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Terrors are turned loose against me; they drive away my dignity as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed like a cloud.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction grip me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Night pierces my bones, and my gnawing pains never rest.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: With great force He grasps my garment; He seizes me by the collar of my tunic.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: He throws me into the mud, and I have become like dust and ashes.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You have ruthlessly turned on me; You oppose me with Your strong hand.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it; You toss me about in the storm.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Yet no one stretches out his hand to a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has my soul not grieved for the needy?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I am churning within and cannot rest; days of affliction confront me.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My skin grows black and peels, and my bones burn with fever.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For what is the allotment of God from above, or the heritage from the Almighty on high?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Does not disaster come to the unjust and calamity to the workers of iniquity?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Does He not see my ways and count my every step?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: let God weigh me with honest scales, that He may know my integrity.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If my steps have turned from the path, if my heart has followed my eyes, or if impurity has stuck to my hands,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then may another eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife, or I have lurked at his door,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then may my own wife grind grain for another, and may other men sleep with her.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For that would be a heinous crime, an iniquity to be judged.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For it is a fire that burns down to Abaddon; it would root out my entire harvest.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they made a complaint against me,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: what will I do when God rises to judge? How will I answer when called to account?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Did not He who made me in the womb also make them? Did not the same One form us in the womb?
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have eaten my morsel alone, not sharing it with the fatherless—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: though from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have seen one perish for lack of clothing, or a needy man without a cloak,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then may my arm fall from my shoulder and be torn from its socket.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: For calamity from God terrifies me, and His splendor I cannot overpower.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have beheld the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: this would also be an iniquity to be judged, for I would have denied God on high.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: If I have rejoiced in my enemy’s ruin, or exulted when evil befell him—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if the men of my house have not said, ‘Who is there who has not had his fill?’—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: but no stranger had to lodge on the street, for my door has been open to the traveler—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: because I greatly feared the crowds and the contempt of the clans terrified me, so that I kept silent and would not go outside—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: (Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown.
name: Job

speaker: job
text: I would give account of all my steps; I would approach Him like a prince.)—
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: if I have devoured its produce without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,
name: Job

speaker: job
text: then let briers grow instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley.
name: Job

speaker: eliphaz
text: If one ventures a word with you, will you be wearied? Yet who can keep from speaking?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Your words have steadied those who stumbled; you have braced the knees that were buckling.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weary. It strikes you, and you are dismayed.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: In disquieting visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: fear and trembling came over me and made all my bones shudder.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Then a spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body bristled.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance; a form loomed before my eyes, and I heard a whispering voice:
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: If God puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Are not their tent cords pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: I have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: His sons are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from the thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For distress does not spring from the dust, and trouble does not sprout from the ground.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: However, if I were you, I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him—
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He gives rain to the earth and sends water upon the fields.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He sets the lowly on high, so that mourners are lifted to safety.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and sweeps away the plans of the cunning.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: In famine He will redeem you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, and will not fear havoc when it comes.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the beasts of the earth.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will know that your tent is secure, and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will know that your offspring will be many, your descendants like the grass of the earth.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Indeed, we have investigated, and it is true! So hear it and know for yourself.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Should he argue with useless words or speeches that serve no purpose?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side— men much older than your father.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: as you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks injustice like water?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He wanders about as food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He will not escape from the darkness; the flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: For you needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: while the land belonged to a mighty man, and a man of honor lived on it.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You sent widows away empty-handed, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden peril terrifies you;
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: it is so dark you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Yet you say: ‘What does God know? Does He judge through thick darkness?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven.’
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod?
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: They said to God, ‘Depart from us. What can the Almighty do to us?’
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: But it was He who filled their houses with good things; so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Receive instruction from His mouth, and lay up His words in your heart.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored. If you remove injustice from your tents
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines,
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: When men are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then He will save the lowly.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: eliphaz
text: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands.
name: Eliphaz the Temanite

speaker: bildad
text: How long will you go on saying such things? The words of your mouth are a blustering wind.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: When your children sinned against Him, He gave them over to their rebellion.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Though your beginnings were modest, your latter days will flourish.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Will they not teach you and tell you, and speak from their understanding?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Do reeds flourish without water?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: While the shoots are still uncut, they dry up quicker than grass.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: His confidence is fragile; his security is in a spider’s web.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He leans on his web, but it gives way; he holds fast, but it does not endure.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He is a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: His roots wrap around the rock heap; he looks for a home among the stones.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: If he is uprooted from his place, it will disown him, saying, ‘I never saw you.’
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Surely this is the joy of his way; yet others will spring from the dust.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with a shout of joy.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: How long until you end these speeches? Show some sense, and then we can talk.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Why are we regarded as cattle, as stupid in your sight?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: You who tear yourself in anger— should the earth be forsaken on your account, or the rocks be moved from their place?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Indeed, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; the flame of his fire does not glow.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: The light in his tent grows dark, and the lamp beside him goes out.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: His vigorous stride is shortened, and his own schemes trip him up.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: For his own feet lead him into a net, and he wanders into its mesh.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: A noose is hidden in the ground, and a trap lies in his path.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: His strength is depleted, and calamity is ready at his side.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: It devours patches of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: The roots beneath him dry up, and the branches above him wither away.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He is driven from light into darkness and is chased from the inhabited world.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: He has no offspring or posterity among his people, no survivor where he once lived.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Those in the west are appalled at his fate, while those in the east tremble in horror.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: bildad
text: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!
name: Bildad the Shuhite

speaker: zophar
text: Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: Should your babbling put others to silence? Will you scoff without rebuke?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: But if only God would speak and open His lips against you,
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves.
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: They are higher than the heavens—what can you do? They are deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: If He comes along to imprison you, or convenes a court, who can stop Him?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: Surely He knows the deceit of men. If He sees iniquity, does He not take note?
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
name: Zophar the Naamathite

speaker: zophar
text: if you put away the iniquity in your hand, and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents,
